name: CreateApplicationPrompt

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You must specify an application with `ApplicationType` set to `mem0`. You can first call the CreateApplication operation with `ApplicationType` set to `mem0` to create an application, and then pass the returned ApplicationId to this operation. This parameter does not apply to other application types such as standard PolarClaw or Supabase
parameters.help_zh: 应用 ID。必须指定 `ApplicationType=mem0` 的应用；可先调用 CreateApplication 并将 ApplicationType 设为 mem0 创建应用，再将返回的 ApplicationId 传入本接口。普通 PolarClaw、Supabase 等其他类型应用不适用
